description: This file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV app, implementing a TV-optimized home screen with multiple rows of media items, custom card presenters with focus scaling and progress indicators, and sample data for movies and channels.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a home screen with multiple horizontal rows of media content, using Leanback library components for Android TV.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Data model representing a media card with title, image, and optional progress indicator.

classes.name: CardPresenterSelector
classes.description: A PresenterSelector that provides a custom presenter for CardItem objects.

classes.name: OPImageCardPresenter
classes.description: A custom Presenter for ImageCardView that handles focus scaling, coloring, loading images from resources, and displaying a progress bar overlay.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a ViewHolder containing an ImageCardView with custom focus behavior.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a CardItem to the ImageCardView, setting image, title, and attaching a progress bar overlay.

methods.name: buildProgressBar
methods.description: Constructs a view representing a progress bar with a specified fill percentage.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the image resource from the view holder to free memory when unbinding.
